verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a code-execution or data-analysis feature in which Grok writes and runs code on user data to produce charts, computed answers, or downloadable files. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: Grok Bot's 'persistent cloud computer' does not say it runs analysis code or returns files, and Google Drive file access or Grok Build coding prompts cover reading data or writing code, not executing it on user data.
